column1: # EUKARYOME's names of the deep lineages beside NCBI's (eukore/eukaryome.py; since 2026-11-14, format 7). EUKARYOME
# names its superkingdoms, kingdoms and many phyla otherwise than NCBI (Straminipila, Rhodoplantae, Heterolobosa,
# Kinetoplastia, ...), so that a species whose genus, family, order and class EUKARYOME does not name is still placed
# under its kingdom (`upward`), and a name two lineages share (a homonym) is told by the kingdom it lies in.
# eukaryome: EUKARYOME 2.1's name (its classification table); rank: its rank there; ncbi: the NCBI taxon of the same
# clade (taxdump of 2026-11; - where NCBI has none); groups: Eukore's groups (data/supergroups.tsv's) the clade holds,
# by which a EUKARYOME kingdom and an NCBI lineage are told apart (- for none: no check).
